title: Famulus audit append request (contract C7)
description: Payload of org.famulus.Audit1.Append: one C1 audit record WITHOUT the writer-assigned members ts, prev_hash and hash. Every other member, its type and constraints are identical to audit-log/audit-record.schema.json (C1); test_audit_service.py locks this equivalence. Floats are forbidden anywhere (enforced by validators, not by this schema).

event_id.description: UUIDv7 uniquely identifying this audit event, lowercase hex only.

conversation_id.description: Opaque non-empty identifier of the conversation this event belongs to, assigned by famulus-agentd (a UUID in practice; the contract constrains only non-emptiness).

actor.description: Who initiated the action: the AI agent, the human user, or the system itself.

tool.description: Tool name exactly as seen by the claude CLI, e.g. "Bash" or "mcp__famulus_desktop__wallpaper_set".

input_redacted.description: The tool input after secret redaction. Free-form object: any properties are allowed inside it. Floats are still forbidden anywhere within (canonical-hashing rule, enforced by validators).

decision.description: Permission decision for this action. Maps to C5 policy behaviors: auto-allow -> "auto-allow"; prompt answered yes -> "user-allow"; prompt answered no -> "user-deny"; deny rule or hard-deny -> "hook-deny".

tier.description: Permission tier of the action: 0 = read-only/no-auth, 1 = user-authenticated, 2 = admin-authenticated. Carried as uint32 ("u") on D-Bus.

snapshot_ref.description: Reference to the btrfs snapshots taken before this action, in the form famulus-snap/<event_id>/<subvols>@<unix_ts>, e.g. famulus-snap/019811a2-7c3e-7d10-9b8a-3f2e1d0c4b5a/etc+var@1751884800. Null when no snapshot was taken. This field is required; use explicit null.

deployment_before.description: rpm-ostree deployment digest active before the action, e.g. an ostree commit checksum or a sha256:<hex> image digest (the contract constrains only non-emptiness). Null when not recorded. This field is required; use explicit null.

result.description: Outcome of the action: ok on success, error on failure or denial, rolled-back when the action was undone via snapshot rollback.
